a7_later_epochs.definition: A7 trials (5-epoch windows, withheld epoch win[2]): share of the window epochs AFTER the withheld one with a V1–V6 FAIL (their requested units enter W)

p0.001.m_star_note: largest m on the grid with P(flag) < 0.5; 20000 = never reaches 0.5 (the whole cell, ≤ 2 packets, can be omitted unflagged)

p0.01.m_star_note: largest m on the grid with P(flag) < 0.5; 20000 = never reaches 0.5 (the whole cell, ≤ 2 packets, can be omitted unflagged)

A10omit.note: 5-epoch windows, attacked epoch win[2]: detected by the per-unit omitted-boost proof whenever a justifying retained unit is in the window; the full-window check is 'a10omit_fullwindow'

bls: not verified: no BLS12-381 library (py_ecc/blst) is installed; V2 checks randomness = SHA-256(signature), the chained link to r*−1 and equality with the stored drand copy, BLS → SKIP

containment.definition: one void epoch ex per trial (withheld before β / voided after β / missed commit window); 5-epoch windows [ex+o, ex+o+4] verified with the 119-epoch prime bundle lacking ex's store, rev1 = committed per-unit τ (validity from the committed τ and the epoch-local floor), rev0 = pre-revision verifier (τ recomputed from rolling features; a chain gap fails the successor). failed = some V1–V6 FAIL in the epoch (its requested units enter W); tau_check = V4 tau_compliance (rev1) / thresholds (rev0) status

grind.note: real drand rounds, ECVRF, BLAKE3 PRF; background = the honest run's committed units of the trial epoch; incident = k payload units fixed before β; candidate j ≥ 1 = one dummy zero-payload unit inserted (new R_e, H(Hdr_e), α_e); constant π policy
